subject.title: Skill and Read tools truncating output at ~600-700 chars in 2026.6.11

question: Should maintainers require a live v2026.6.11 or current-main reproduction of the 600-700 character tool cutoff and Skill Workshop proposal lookup failure before authorizing a fix?
rationale: The obvious source caps are much higher than the report, and the remaining likely causes span display sanitization, transcript compaction, model-visible context, and workspace-scoped proposal lookup.

options.title: Require Live Repro First
options.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the exact truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

options.title: Investigate Source Paths Now
options.body: Assign a maintainer or agent to trace display, embedded-runner, and Skill Workshop state flows from source without waiting for reporter proof, accepting higher risk of chasing the wrong layer.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Output Issue
options.body: Treat only the read-tool truncation portion as covered by #84659 and require a new issue for Skill Workshop state loss, at the cost of splitting a possibly shared root cause.

recommendation.title: Require Live Repro First
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open but block fix automation until a packaged Linux gateway run captures the exact truncation and proposal-state failure with transcript and workspace evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: This issue crosses Skill Workshop proposal scoping and agent/tool runtime behavior, and vincentkoc has the strongest central history signal among the inspected owners.
